Chevening Scholarships

Provider: Chevening

Degree: one-year master's degrees in the UK

Field of study: any eligible UK master's course including Computer Science

Funding Type: Chevening Scholarships are fully-funded, covering tuition fees and a monthly stipend

Chevening-eligible countries: Afghanistan, Albania, Benin, Ghana, India

Country of study: United Kingdom

Eligibility criteria: To be eligible you must be a citizen of a Chevening-eligible country. Have at least two years' work experience, acquired after completing your undergraduate degree, equivalent to 2,800 hours. International applicants may apply from abroad.

Deadline: 5 November 2030
